conservation.technical_description:
*Support:* Wood panel. Panel support is relatively flat and there does not appear to be any cracks 
*Surface Coating:* The oil paint is securely attached to the underlying priming layer. There are no areas of flaking or cleaving paint. Minor surface grime can be found around the edges and in the background. 
*Framing, Backing and Hanging Hardware:* Outer frame (2003) is gray painted wood, now in fair condition. The metal strip frame was conserved in 2008 to secure screws for travel.

description: The white petals of a datura flower bloom to reveal its green center. The datura hovers at the center of the composition. Behind the flower, craggy red and orange hills stretch out across the bottom three quarters of the canvas. In the distance, Pedernal, painted in shades of blue, rises above the hills. A thin strip of blue sky hangs over the scene.
